title: Match output
description: One record per (case_id, trial). Produced by match_stage.py. Cache location: {cache_root}/{model}/match/<extractor>.jsonl. Schema source: match_stage.schema().

id.description: Case ID (e.g. Card001 or Card001-3 for a perturbation variant).

model.description: Canonical model name that produced the responses (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6).

judge.description: Short judge name (e.g. gemini-3-flash). Stripped of vendor prefixes and -preview.

actions.description: Extracted response actions with rubric-option matches.

id.description: Per-record action identifier; 1-indexed, monotonic within the record.

match.description: Comma-separated rubric option IDs (or "harm:..." for nonrubric harms). Empty string for unmatched.

partial.description: Partial-credit flag from the matcher; the review step may also shift it.

matched_action_ids.description: Which actions[].id values matched this option (used by the group step).

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the rendered prompt template; used for cache staleness checks.
